p='topo.py'; s=open(p).read()
i = s.index("        order = np.argsort(src, kind='stable')")
j = s.index("    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    def csr(self, g, want_kind=False):")
new = '''        # waiting edges: one local interval per phase-device
        pw = np.arange(P, dtype=np.int64).reshape(P, 1)
        iw = np.arange(N, dtype=np.int64).reshape(1, N)
        wsrc = (pw * N + iw).reshape(-1)
        wdst = (((pw + 1) % P) * N + iw).reshape(-1)
        wwb = self.vT.T.reshape(-1)
        wde = np.ones(P * N, dtype=np.int64)
        wkind = np.full(P * N, -1, dtype=np.int64)
        wgmax = np.full(P * N, 1 << 40, dtype=np.int64)
        wbl = np.ones(P * N, dtype=bool)
        # merge the two source-sorted edge sets once; every guard mask keeps
        # the resulting order, so bincount remains a valid grouping
        if len(src):
            pa = np.arange(len(src), dtype=np.int64) + \\
                np.searchsorted(wsrc, src, side='left')
            pb = np.arange(len(wsrc), dtype=np.int64) + \\
                np.searchsorted(src, wsrc, side='right')
            ntot = len(src) + len(wsrc)
            self.e_src = np.empty(ntot, dtype=np.int64)
            self.e_dst = np.empty(ntot, dtype=np.int64)
            self.e_wb = np.empty(ntot, dtype=np.int64)
            self.e_de = np.empty(ntot, dtype=np.int64)
            self.e_kind = np.empty(ntot, dtype=np.int64)
            self.e_gmax = np.empty(ntot, dtype=np.int64)
            self.e_bl = np.empty(ntot, dtype=bool)
            for out, a1, a2 in ((self.e_src, src, wsrc), (self.e_dst, dst, wdst),
                                (self.e_wb, wb, wwb), (self.e_de, de, wde),
                                (self.e_kind, kind, wkind),
                                (self.e_gmax, gmax, wgmax),
                                (self.e_bl, blok, wbl)):
                out[pa] = a1
                out[pb] = a2
            del src, dst, wb, de, kind, gmax, blok, wsrc, wdst, wwb, wde, wkind
            del wgmax, wbl, pa, pb
        else:
            self.e_src = wsrc
            self.e_dst = wdst
            self.e_wb = wwb
            self.e_de = wde
            self.e_kind = wkind
            self.e_gmax = wgmax
            self.e_bl = wbl
        wbl_ = self.e_wb.tolist()
        del_ = self.e_de.tolist()
        self.e_wpy = [(a << AGE_SH) + b for a, b in zip(wbl_, del_)]
